name: Conjure Elemental
summary: Conjures an intangible elemental spirit that restrains and damages a creature.

stats.effect:
You conjure a Large, intangible spirit from the Elemental Planes that appears in an unoccupied space within range. Choose the spirit's element, which determines its damage type: air (Lightning), earth (Thunder), fire (Fire), or water (Cold). The spirit lasts for the duration.

Whenever a creature you can see enters the spirit's space or starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature {ref:condition/restrained}. On failed save, the target takes 8d8 damage of the spirit's type, and the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the spell ends. At the start of each of its turns, the {ref:condition/restrained} target repeats the save. On a failed save, the target takes 4d8 damage of the spirit's type. On a successful save, the target isn't {ref:condition/restrained} by the spirit.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.
